Subject: Technical handoff and architecture session — BlueHarbor (post-discovery)

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call earlier this week. We'd like to follow up with a focused technical handoff / architecture session where our infra/SE team walks through how Redwood would sit in your environment and covers the specific topics we flagged during discovery (KV cache strategy, routing/fallbacks, data isolation for tenancy).

Proposed agenda (30–45m):
- 5m quick intros + goals
- 15m infra/architecture overview (runtime, routing, caching, quantization options)
- 10m integration points (networking, authentication, data flows)
- 10m open Q&A and next steps

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue Apr 13: 9:00–9:45am PDT
- Wed Apr 14: 11:00–11:45am PDT
- Mon Apr 19: 1:00–1:45pm PDT

If those don't work, tell me your preferred windows and timezone and we'll pivot. Please also confirm the attendee list on your side — you mentioned bringing an architect and someone from procurement.

I've attached a short session agenda and a one-page runtime overview for context.

Thanks,
Marissa
